solution.title: Healthcare Shared Clinical Device Management — WOWs, Kiosks & Tablets in Microsoft Intune

products.name: Healthcare Shared Clinical Device Management — WOWs, Kiosks & Tablets in Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Provision, standardize, and lock down shared clinical Windows devices — WOWs, kiosks, nurse-station PCs, and tablets — with Microsoft Intune: Autopilot self-deploying, Windows Shared PC mode for fast multi-user logon, Assigned Access kiosk where single-purpose, a clinical app baseline, and always-on power for carts. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Any shift, any clinician, any cart — a shared clinical device that's always ready

Shared clinical devices drift: WOWs and kiosks get hand-built, multi-user logon is slow, carts fall asleep mid-round, and no two devices are configured alike. This solution makes them standardized, shared appliances in Microsoft Intune: provisioned hands-off with Autopilot self-deploying, configured with Windows Shared PC mode for fast many-user logon, kiosk-locked with Assigned Access where single-purpose, given a consistent clinical app baseline, and kept always-on on the cart — with no personal-owner affinity. (Epic-client and Imprivata depth live in their dedicated solutions; this package owns the shared-device provisioning, standardization, and lock-down.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the shared, no-owner device model, Shared PC mode vs kiosk Assigned Access, and self-deploying provisioning.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing, Autopilot + hardware-hash registration, Win10/11 edition supporting Shared PC/Assigned Access, device group, shared-account model, clinical app set, network, cart hardware) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, full-path steps: Autopilot self-deploying profile, Shared PC mode config, kiosk Assigned Access where applicable, clinical app baseline (Required), WOW always-on power, then pilot → validate → expand. Every object named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — shared-device discovery, per-device validation, fleet report, safe remediation (clear stray primary user / re-assign profiles), and a dynamic shared-device group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices for shared clinical fleets.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A fleet of standardized, self-provisioning shared clinical devices — WOWs, kiosks, and tablets — that any clinician can use instantly, locked down where needed and always ready on the cart, managed at fleet scale by your own team.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CLINDEV-Discovery.ps1 — Inventory shared clinical Windows devices (WOWs, kiosks, nurse-station
    • CLINDEV-Remediation.ps1 — Safe, gated remediation for shared clinical Windows devices in
    • CLINDEV-Report.ps1 — Fleet report for shared clinical Windows devices managed by Microsoft
    • CLINDEV-Set-SharedDeviceGroup.ps1 — Create the dynamic 'Clinical - Shared Devices' Entra group
    • CLINDEV-Validation.ps1 — Per-device PASS/FAIL validation for shared clinical Windows devices in

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
